card.name: Avoid and restricted-program wording
card.fires_on: Directive words in warnings: 'Avoid' or 'Recommended' starting a dosing or warning phrase, and 'through' or 'a' in 'available only through a restricted program' (REMS).

modes.label: Avoid / Recommended openers
modes.description: Sentence-opening 'Avoid' or 'Recommended' after a sedation or dosing statement.
modes.example: coma, and death.<< Avoid>> the use of Hydrocodone Polist

modes.label: Restricted program wording
modes.description: 'through' or 'a' in 'available only through a restricted program' in REMS sections.
modes.example: MYALEPT is available only<< through>> a restricted distribution program

card.plain: It fires on instruction words in warnings, such as 'avoid', and on the phrase saying a drug is available only through a restricted program.
